purpose: Real-model whole-process generation comparison for the paired-output FP32 remainder-row candidate
method: Fresh-process wall-clock `/usr/bin/time -p` for `generate -temperature 0` (greedy); alternating reference/candidate order within the same session. Includes weight load, dequantization, tokenizer, prompt prefill and decode. Identical completion text verified by SHA-256 of stdout.

tokens_256_long_decode.prompt: Write a detailed history of the city of Tokyo.

q8_control_tokens_32.note: Q8 weights use linearQ8Into/linearQ8WideInto/dotQ8PairBlock64, not linearFP32Range; included as a no-regression control

decode_estimate.note: 32 vs 64 token wall-clock deltas approximate per-token decode cost including fixed load/prefill

limitations: Single model, greedy sampling, threads=4, on one Apple M4 host; f32 timing claims do not extend to q8/q4 kernels which the candidate does not touch
Wall-clock includes weight load and dequantization; not a serving-throughput measurement
The q8 comparison is a no-regression control (ratio ~1.00), not an improvement claim
No claim for other models, other platforms, prefill-heavy workloads or tail latency
Single 64-token observation per binary; 256-token comparison uses two runs each
